brief: Reposition a science-founded premium nutrition brand to stand out as different and better in a crowded category: strike a strong emotional chord with customers, own a defensible market positioning, and give customers a guided path through the product lifecycle - without getting lost in the science-heavy product-attribute details that currently confuse newcomers.
constraints: Every SKU contains a proprietary blend of 16 target nutrients at several times the category's conventional density - the science must support the story, not bury it
Clarify the portfolio: customers cannot tell the product lines apart
Products can be bundled by life stage but do not have to be - stage-based messaging currently confuses newcomers
Leverage existing proof points: an independent third-party purity certification, the research-nutritionist founder story, whole-food ingredients, no added sugar
The category is saturated with sweeter, less nutrient-dense products from well-funded competitors
audience: health-motivated households - first-time buyers especially - navigating the category for the first time, motivated by outcomes but overwhelmed by science-heavy claims and skeptical of premium-nutrition marketing
